decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application, and the plans Design and Access Statement, J569 PL 309, J569 PL 543 and J569 PL 115 submitted on the 29 November 2010, and plans
J569 PL 001, J569 PL 121, J569 PL 122, J569 PL 123, J569 PL 124, J569 PL 125, J569 PL 126 and J569 PL 310 submitted on the 30 November 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external face of the screens hereby permitted shall match those used on the existing screening for the external stairs.
Condition : 4 - The mechanical plant hereby approved shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site.
description: Addition of external screened mechanical plant to roof of Hotel
